name: ops-control
description: Ops Control for Claude Code: a cockpit pane for changes, subagents and context, an activity band, and shareable themes.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Theme name: ops-control, aurora, dusk, classic, cyberpunk, vaporwave, high-contrast, or one in ~/.claude/ops-control/themes

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: No shimmer or spinner animation from ops-control

pack.title: Pack
pack.description: Pack name: classic, crt, cozy, arcade, or one in ~/.claude/ops-control/packs

spinner.title: Spinner
spinner.description: Spinner name: stock, comet, eyes, orb-states, clawd, shimmer, scanline, ring, glitch, signal, or pack for the pack's own

pet.title: Pet
pet.description: clawd, robot, ghost, lelouch, shikamaru, gojo, levi, off, or a pet in ~/.claude/ops-control/pets

bubbles.title: Speech bubbles
bubbles.description: on (template lines), off, or haiku (Claude Haiku writes some lines; small paid calls on your account)

statusline.title: Status line fields
statusline.description: Comma-separated, in order: activity, ctx, 5h, week, cost, model, effort, agents, plan, branch, changes, cwd, level, music. A / starts a second line.
